title: Deploy the marketing publication stack to papyrus-production and connect Amplify
description:
Auritus-web main (2a9ed05) now targets papyrus-production 712236451410 (decision 2026-10-18, Auritus-web #3 and #4). The template infra/marketing-publication.yml creates a private S3 bucket, a CloudFront candidate with no alias, and one Amplify-only IAM role scoped to that bucket. Nothing has been deployed to 712236451410 yet.

STEPS (all AWS work runs on Ryan's M1 Mac through Remote Control; cloud threads have no AWS access because access keys are blocked and login is SSO with a thumbprint):
1. Verify the SSO profile resolves to account 712236451410 before anything else.
2. Follow docs/SCOPED_ACCESS_REQUEST.md in Auritus-web with the stack name and profile it names, adjusted for the new account. Read the doc first; it was written for 961068435042 and the account-specific values must be re-checked.
3. Ryan creates the Amplify WEB app on AnthusAI/Auritus-web main in the AWS console through the GitHub App (cannot be scripted), sets the service role to the stack's AmplifyPublicationBuildRole output, sets AURITUS_PUBLICATION_BUCKET to the stack's bucket output, keeps auto-build on.
4. Prove a source-triggered publish: push to main, confirm the build publishes to the bucket and the CloudFront candidate serves it.

GATES: no DNS, Cognito, or Legacy changes. Cutover of aurit.us needs separate exact approval. Do not widen the IAM role on failure; report the CloudFormation event reason instead.

Source: Claude Code Projects handoff, 2026-10-19.
